scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date regardless of Assessment Date

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS_001_003 is "Edge"

For id TC_TS_001_003, no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record; examples include "Disposition is Completed and Validation Status is Accepted for the AR PASSE inbound 834 file.", "Policy unit delivery is successful and the member transaction is available for Facets verification.", and "Evidence confirms the boundary rule is implemented correctly: when multiple Eligibility Dates are present for an unstarted AR PASSE new enrollment, Facets populates transaction effective date from the first Eligibility Date value only."
